VI.description: Sets the show state of the window hWnd through user32.dll ShowWindow (stdcall\2C called in any thread). nCmdShow 4 SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE restores a minimized window without activating it; 9 SW_RESTORE restores and activates; 0 SW_HIDE hides it. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Show command\2C e.g. 4 SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE\2C 9 SW_RESTORE\2C 6 SW_MINIMIZE\2C 0 SW_HIDE.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: Non-zero when the window was visible BEFORE the call\2C 0 when it was hidden.
